gui.vc-audio-distance.colors.tooltip: Colors that stay apart with red-green color blindness: blue for talking, purple for whispers, orange for walls. Radar marks also differ in shape.
gui.vc-audio-distance.done.tooltip: Save and close. Esc does the same.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.corners.no: No voice comes round a corner right now
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.corners.to:
A voice behind a wall also comes round it through a doorway or window.
The sharper the turn, the duller it sounds.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.place.tool: Sound follows where you are: deep caves and the deep dark ring more, the Nether's smoke dulls far voices, the End's open void gives no echo, snow and dense jungles swallow sound. Mild, on top of what is measured.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.hint: The echo comes from the space around you and around the speaker; water and rain from where you both are.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.no_world: Join a world to see your surroundings.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.reverb.str: How loud the echo is compared to the voice.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.reverb.too:
Voices echo like the place: briefly in a stone room, long in a cave, not at all in a forest or field.
Close voices stay clear.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.space.fore: Forest: the leaves swallow the echo
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.space.dead: Soft room: wool and hay swallow the echo
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.space.semi: Half-open place: a light short echo
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.space.smal: Small room: a short ringing echo
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.space.wood: Wooden room: a short warm echo
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.space.tunn: Tunnel: a short echo along it
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.space.larg: Cave or big hall: a long rolling echo
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.space.cany: Cliffs around: they send the voice back
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.room.detai: Echo lasts %s s, walls about %s bl. away
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.room.repea: The voice comes back after %s s
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.sound_phys: It already adds echo and underwater sound to voices, so ours stay off. Rain still works.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.water.tool: When your head or the speaker's is under water, voices become dull and quiet.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.water.unde: Your head is under water: every voice is dull and quiet
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.weather.ra: Rain: far voices are harder to hear
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.weather.th: Thunderstorm: far voices are much harder to hear
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.weather.to: Under the open sky, rain makes far voices quieter and a thunderstorm even more. Close voices stay clear.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.water.stre: How dull and quiet voices get under water. 100% is the usual, up to 150%.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.weather.st: How much rain and thunder cover far voices. 100% is the usual, up to 150%.
gui.vc-audio-distance.falloff.tooltip:
How strongly the voice fades with distance.
100% = normal, 0% = same volume everywhere in range.
gui.vc-audio-distance.floor.tooltip:
The curve ends at this volume at the edge of the range: the whole fade is fitted to it.
Scaled by each player's own volume, so muted players stay muted.
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.background.too: How visible the HUD's background is. 0% leaves only the text.
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.compact.toolti: One line for everyone talking (the closest voice and how many more) instead of a line per voice.
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.contrast.toolt: A solid black panel with white text, easy to read against any background. For low vision.
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.markers.toolti: Who is talking, with an arrow to their side, in a line above the hotbar, like subtitles: ◀ Anna 6m, Bob 6m ▶. Helps if you cannot tell where a voice comes from by ear.
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.corner.tooltip: Which corner of the screen the voice HUD sits in.
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.group.isolated: Group: %s (isolated) — only the group hears you
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.group.open: Group: %s (open) — they hear you anywhere, and players nearby too
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.hidden: This server hides nearby players in the HUD
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.mode.tooltip:
A small panel: who is talking nearby, how far and from where, and while you talk how many hear you.
There is also a key for it in Controls.
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.nobody_whisper: Nobody is close enough for a whisper
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.preview.off: The HUD is off: only short notices (zones, the HUD key) appear.
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.scale.tooltip: Size of the voice HUD on the screen.
gui.vc-audio-distance.inspect.speaker: %s · %s bl. · %s
gui.vc-audio-distance.listen.tooltip: Plays a voice walking away from you along this curve, so you hear how it fades.
gui.vc-audio-distance.locked.tooltip: Set by this server while you play here.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.door.tool: Wooden doors and trapdoors (only when the ray hits the door itself). An open one counts a tenth.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.earth.too:
Dirt, grass, sand, gravel, clay, mud, snow:
everything you dig with a shovel.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.ice.toolt: Ice, packed ice and blue ice.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.leaves.to: Leaves let most of the sound through.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.liquid.to: Every block of liquid between you and the speaker.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.metal.too: Blocks of iron, gold, copper and netherite, anvils, iron and copper doors.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.other.too:
Every solid block not listed here:
bedrock, blocks from other mods and so on.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.soft.tool:
Hay, sponge, moss, sculk, dried kelp –
soft blocks that swallow sound.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.stone.too:
Stone, bricks, concrete, terracotta, ores:
everything you mine with a pickaxe.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.thin.tool: Fences, gates, iron bars – mostly open.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.wood.tool:
Logs, planks and wooden blocks:
everything you chop with an axe.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.wool.tool: Wool and carpets – the best sound insulation.
gui.vc-audio-distance.materials.hint: How much one block muffles, compared to stone (100%).
gui.vc-audio-distance.materials.hint_oth: Blocks that are not listed count as "Other blocks".
gui.vc-audio-distance.materials.reset.to: Every material back to its default.
gui.vc-audio-distance.materials.section: Materials: how much each block muffles
gui.vc-audio-distance.distance.more.tool: Curve shape, volume at the edge and the range of full volume. The two sliders above are enough for most players.
gui.vc-audio-distance.blocks.hint: Blocks from other mods, or ones the guess gets wrong, can count as a material you choose.
gui.vc-audio-distance.blocks.look.toolti: Adds the block in your crosshair as stone; then pick its material. Look at the block before you open this screen.
gui.vc-audio-distance.blocks.hand.toolti: Adds the block your held item places as stone; then pick its material.
gui.vc-audio-distance.blocks.field.toolt: A block id like create:andesite_casing, or a tag like #c:glass_blocks.
gui.vc-audio-distance.blocks.add.tooltip: Adds the id or tag as stone; then pick its material.
gui.vc-audio-distance.blocks.material.to: Click to choose the next material for this block.
gui.vc-audio-distance.blocks.invalid: That is not a block id or tag. Example: create:andesite_casing or #c:glass_blocks
gui.vc-audio-distance.blocks.added: Added %s as stone: pick its material.
gui.vc-audio-distance.blocks.none_looked: No block in your crosshair. Look at a block, then open this screen.
gui.vc-audio-distance.blocks.none_held: Nothing in your hand that places a block.
Most of the loudness is gone soon after the full-volume distance,
then voices fade to silence at the edge. Tense and quiet.
gui.vc-audio-distance.model.inverse.tool:
How sound behaves in the open: loudness drops quickly at first,
then slowly, and fades out over the last quarter of the range.
gui.vc-audio-distance.model.label: Curve: %s
gui.vc-audio-distance.model.linear.toolt:
Simple Voice Chat's own curve: full volume up to the
full-volume distance, then a straight fade to silence.
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.col.name: Player
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.empty: Nobody is within voice range right now.
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.empty_hint: Players within earshot show up here: who is talking, how loud, and through which walls.
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.no_world: Join a world to see who is nearby.
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.off_by_ser: The server turned off the monitor
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.server.non: Server: no addon (walls are muffled only on your side)
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.states_unk: Who has no voice chat or turned the sound off shows with Simple Voice Chat 2.6.1+ or the addon on the server.
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.view.toolt: List: every player with distance, loudness and walls. Radar: a map seen from above, you in the middle looking up; the rings are the voice and whisper range.
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.atmospheric:
Only people right next to you (about 7 blocks) are loud,
voices fade fast and walls muffle strongly. For horror and stealth.
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.default.too:
Exactly what Simple Voice Chat does on its own:
full volume up to half the range, then a straight fade. Walls off.
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.high_audibi:
Everyone stays understandable: full volume up to about 24 blocks,
gentle fade, 25% at the edge, walls off. Good for events.
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.realistic.t:
Like sound in real life: full volume up to about 12 blocks,
then a natural fade with a quiet edge. Walls muffle voices.
gui.vc-audio-distance.reference.tooltip:
Up to this distance voices play at full volume,
then they start to fade. Simple Voice Chat uses half the range.
gui.vc-audio-distance.reset.distance.too: Back to Simple Voice Chat's own curve: full volume up to half the range, then a straight fade.
gui.vc-audio-distance.reset.effects.tool: Echo at 60%; water, rain and corners on.
gui.vc-audio-distance.reset.hud.tooltip: HUD while talking, top right, normal size, background and colors.
gui.vc-audio-distance.reset.walls.toolti: Walls on at 60%, every material back to its default.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.apply.toolt:
This server suggests its own sound profile.
Apply copies it into your settings; you can still change or cancel it.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.dead.toolti: Dead players are not heard until they respawn.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.enforced.fr: Server profile in use · this tab is yours
Dead players are not heard by their Simple Voice Chat group either, until they respawn.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.group.open_: Zone range, sneaking and the megaphone also work for the nearby voice of players in open groups.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.group.spect: Spectators in a group are heard only by the spectators in it.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.group.zones: An isolated zone also cuts group voices between the players inside and outside it.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.hint: Changes are saved on the server right away. More: /vcd help
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.locked.tool: While the server's profile is enforced, players cannot change these parts; the rest stays their own. Locked walls lock each block's percentage too.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.megaphone.t: A goat horn in hand makes the voice carry further (/vcd rule megaphone for another item).
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.monitor.too: Off: players see no monitor, no radar and no nearby players in the HUD, so nobody sees others through walls.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.preset.tool: The server's sound. "Custom" uses the profile values from the settings file.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.profile.too: How the server's profile reaches players with the addon: off, suggested, or enforced while they play here.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.require.too: What happens to players with Simple Voice Chat but without this addon: nothing, one message, a message every join, or a kick.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.server_wall: The server muffles walls for players who have plain Simple Voice Chat.
Spectators are heard only by other spectators.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.walls.toolt: How strongly walls muffle voices, for everyone.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.zone.create: A 17×17×17 box around you. Pick it below to set it up; /vcd zone for exact corners.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.zone.delete: Deletes the zone on the server.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.zone.echo.t: An echo everywhere in the zone (a cathedral), none, or measured as usual.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.zone.isolat: Voices neither leave nor enter the zone.
How far voices carry in this zone: ×2 for a stage, ×0.4 for a library.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.zone.show.t: Draws the zone's borders with particles for 30 seconds. Only you see them.
Wall strength for players in this zone.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.zones.none: No zones yet: make one with the button on the right, or /vcd zone.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.notices.too: Players see a zone's name above the hotbar when they enter or leave it, with or without the addon.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.section.fol: Click to fold or unfold this section.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.log.undo.to: Takes back the last change made with /vcd or on this tab (up to 10 in a row).
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.log.open.to: Opens the whole change log on its own screen: page by page, and by player.
gui.vc-audio-distance.log.title: Change log
gui.vc-audio-distance.log.filter.tooltip: Shows only this player's changes: type a name, or console. Empty shows everyone.
gui.vc-audio-distance.log.copy.tooltip: Copies the lines of this page to the clipboard.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.zone.pos1.t: Marks the block you stand on as one corner of a new zone.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.zone.pos2.t: Marks the block you look at (up to 64 blocks away) as the other corner. The selection is shown with particles.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.zone.create: Makes a zone between the two corners you marked.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.zone.tp.too: Takes you to the middle of the zone.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.zone.rename: Type a new name (letters, digits, - and _) in the field and press Rename. The zone's settings are kept.
gui.vc-audio-distance.status.sound_physi: It already muffles voices through walls, so ours stays off.
gui.vc-audio-distance.status.unavailable: Wall muffling is not available in this build
This file has the distance curve only. Walls, echo and the HUD are in the full version.
gui.vc-audio-distance.strength.tooltip:
How much walls affect voices.
60% ≈ one stone wall clearly muffles a voice.
gui.vc-audio-distance.summary.flat: Same volume everywhere up to %s bl.
gui.vc-audio-distance.title: Voice Physics
gui.vc-audio-distance.walls.hint: Sound bends around edges: a half-open doorway muffles less than a wall.
gui.vc-audio-distance.walls.preview_off: Wall muffling is off – preview of what it would do
gui.vc-audio-distance.walls.toggle.toolt:
Voices behind walls, doors and floors become quieter and muffled,
depending on what is in between.
gui.vc-audio-distance.whisper.tooltip:
How much faster whispers fade than normal speech.
100% = the same, higher = whispers fade sooner.
message.vc-audio-distance.button.tooltip: Distance, walls, echo, the HUD and the monitor.
message.vc-audio-distance.server_profile: [Voice Physics] This server uses its own sound profile while you play here. Your own settings return when you leave.
[Voice Physics] This server suggests a sound profile. Open the settings to apply it:
message.vc-audio-distance.welcome.button: [Voice Physics] Voices now fade with distance and are muffled by walls. Settings: voice chat settings (V) → "Voice Physics…" or /voicephysics.
message.vc-audio-distance.welcome.key: [Voice Physics] Voices now fade with distance and are muffled by walls. Settings: %s or /voicephysics.
message.vc-audio-distance.cmd.locked: The server keeps this part of its sound profile while you play here.
message.vc-audio-distance.cmd.code.show: Your profile code. Share it; others load it with /voicephysics code <code>:
message.vc-audio-distance.cmd.code.inval: That is not a profile code (they start with %s).
message.vc-audio-distance.cmd.status.no_: This server has no Voice Physics: your own settings apply.
message.vc-audio-distance.cmd.help.title: Voice Physics - your commands (click one to type it):
message.vc-audio-distance.cmd.help.open: /voicephysics [distance|walls|effects|hud|monitor|server] - open the settings, on a tab
message.vc-audio-distance.cmd.help.hud: /voicephysics hud off|talking|always, hud compact on|off - the voice HUD
message.vc-audio-distance.cmd.help.code: /voicephysics code [code] - copy your profile code, or load one
message.vc-audio-distance.cmd.help.reset: /voicephysics reset curve|walls|materials|effects|hud|all - back to the defaults
message.vc-audio-distance.cmd.help.statu: /voicephysics status - what this server does to your sound
message.vc-audio-distance.cmd.help.repor: /voicephysics report - versions, settings and recent problems as one text to copy into a bug report
message.vc-audio-distance.cmd.report.hin: Click Copy and paste it into an issue on GitHub. The text is in English and has no names.
message.vc-audio-distance.cmd.log.admin: The change log is for server admins.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.vc-audio-: Voices behave like sound: they fade with distance, get muffled by walls, come round corners and echo in caves. A HUD shows who is talking and who hears you. Servers get sound zones, game rules and walls even for players without the addon.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.vc-audio-dist: Voices that fade with distance, get muffled by walls and echo in caves, for Simple Voice Chat.
command.vc-audio-distance.help.speaker: /vcd speaker [list|add <name> [radius] [pickup]|remove <name>|tp <name>] - loudspeakers: whoever talks at one is heard from it
command.vc-audio-distance.speaker.title: Loudspeakers (whoever talks near one is heard from it)
command.vc-audio-distance.speaker.none: No loudspeakers placed. Stand where it should be and use /vcd speaker add <name>.
command.vc-audio-distance.speaker.need_p: Only a player can place a speaker (it goes where they stand).
command.vc-audio-distance.speaker.no_tp: Could not teleport there from here.
command.vc-audio-distance.speaker.off_no: The loudspeakers switch is off, so this one is silent: /vcd extras speakers on.
command.vc-audio-distance.help.eavesdrop: /vcd eavesdrop [item <id>|none|factor <0.05-1>] - eavesdropping: the item that makes walls sound thinner, and by how much
command.vc-audio-distance.eavesdrop.titl: Eavesdropping (holding the item makes walls sound thinner)
command.vc-audio-distance.eavesdrop.item: Players must hold %s to eavesdrop. Saved.
Nobody can eavesdrop now (no item set). Saved.
command.vc-audio-distance.eavesdrop.fact: Eavesdroppers hear %s of the walls' muffling. Saved.
